name: Surge XT
title: Surge XT: free Serum 2 alternative
caption:
Serum 2 costs $249. Surge XT makes your own synth sounds for free 🎹

✅ Over 2,800 ready-made sounds to start from
✅ 3 oscillators per scene, with 12 oscillator types
✅ Filters, LFOs and 27 effects to shape your sound
✅ Runs inside your music app, or on its own

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ Surge XT works best as a plugin inside a music app (a DAW), though it also runs standalone. Serum 2 is a one-time $249 purchase

Comment "SYNTH" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

beats.say: Serum 2 costs two hundred forty nine dollars. This synth costs zero.
A synth is how you make your own sounds in your music software.
Serum 2 is two hundred forty nine, once. Surge XT is nothing.
Surge XT comes with over twenty eight hundred ready-made sounds.
Build your own with oscillators, filters and effects.
Open it inside your music app, or run it all by itself.
Nobody needs to pay for this.
